newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 24.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
I'LL BE GOOD NOW PLEDGES THE NEXT MP

Following one of the most remarkable political comebacks of the decade, former Defence Minister Alan Clark renowned for philandering and blunt speaking has offered a good behaviour pledge to Parliament and to his Kensington and Chelsea constituency voters. He pronounced himself delighted that he had secured the Conservative nomination for the safe seat.
TESCO GOES HYPER TO TACKLE BIG TWO RIVALS
Tesco is keen to expand its operation into hypermarkets in a move that would directly challenge competitors Sainsbury and Asda. The new style store would be called Tesco Plus.

One of London's most respected independent financial advisers, Fiona Price has attacked life insurer Scottish Amicable. She also urges Scottish Amicable's owner policyholders to throw out the plan to demutualise and float the company on the Stock Exchange.
